# MatchFileContext { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchFileContext }

```python
alignment.MatchFileContext(
    piece='',
    composer='',
    performer='',
    score_filename='',
    midi_filename='',
    midi_clock_units=480,
    midi_clock_rate=500000,
    score_notes=dict(),
    perf_notes=dict(),
    score_properties=list(),
    deletions=list(),
    insertions=list(),
)
```

Supplementary data required for ``.match`` file export.

This context object bridges the gap between the coordinate-only
:class:`~timetoalign.MatchStamp` data and the rich note-level data
required by the Vienna ``.match`` format.  It is typically constructed
via :meth:`from_dataframes` or assembled manually.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                                                                                  | Description                                                                                   |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| piece            | [str](`str`)                                                                                                          | Piece name for the ``info(piece,...)`` header.                                                |
| composer         | [str](`str`)                                                                                                          | Composer name for the ``info(composer,...)`` header.                                          |
| performer        | [str](`str`)                                                                                                          | Performer name for the ``info(performer,...)`` header.                                        |
| score_filename   | [str](`str`)                                                                                                          | Score file name for the header.                                                               |
| midi_filename    | [str](`str`)                                                                                                          | MIDI file name for the header.                                                                |
| midi_clock_units | [int](`int`)                                                                                                          | MIDI clock units (divisions per quarter note).                                                |
| midi_clock_rate  | [int](`int`)                                                                                                          | MIDI clock rate in microseconds per quarter note.                                             |
| score_notes      | [dict](`dict`)\[[float](`float`), [list](`list`)\[[SnoteRecord](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.SnoteRecord`)\]\] | Lookup from score coordinate to list of :class:`SnoteRecord` objects at that coordinate.      |
| perf_notes       | [dict](`dict`)\[[float](`float`), [list](`list`)\[[NoteRecord](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.NoteRecord`)\]\]   | Lookup from performance coordinate to list of :class:`NoteRecord` objects at that coordinate. |
| score_properties | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\]                                                                                        | Pre-formatted ``scoreprop(...)`` lines.                                                       |
| deletions        | [list](`list`)\[[SnoteRecord](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.SnoteRecord`)\]                                     | Score notes with no performance match.                                                        |
| insertions       | [list](`list`)\[[NoteRecord](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.NoteRecord`)\]                                       | Performance notes with no score match.                                                        |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_dataframes](#timetoalign.alignment.MatchFileContext.from_dataframes) | Build a :class:`MatchFileContext` from score and performance DataFrames. |

### from_dataframes { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchFileContext.from_dataframes }

```python
alignment.MatchFileContext.from_dataframes(
    score_df,
    perf_df,
    match_result=None,
    *,
    piece='',
    composer='',
    performer='',
    score_filename='',
    midi_filename='',
    midi_clock_units=480,
    midi_clock_rate=500000,
    score_coord_column='quarterbeats_playthrough',
    perf_coord_column='start',
    score_pitch_column='pitch',
    perf_pitch_column='pitch',
    score_staff_column='staff',
    score_duration_column='duration_qb',
    score_measure_column='mc',
    score_beat_column='beat',
    score_offset_column='mc_onset',
)
```

Build a :class:`MatchFileContext` from score and performance DataFrames.

This factory is designed for the how03 use case: matching EEP
performance notes against unfolded ABC score notes.  It constructs
:class:`SnoteRecord` and :class:`NoteRecord` objects from DataFrame
columns, keyed by their coordinates for lookup during export.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                  | Type                | Description                                                                                                                                                            | Default                      |
|-----------------------|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| score_df              | \'DataFrame\'       | Score notes DataFrame (e.g. from ``prepare_abc_notes_for_matching``). Must contain the ``score_coord_column`` and note attribute columns.                              | _required_                   |
| perf_df               | \'DataFrame\'       | Performance notes DataFrame (e.g. from ``prepare_eep_notes_for_matching``). Must contain the ``perf_coord_column`` and ``pitch`` column.                               | _required_                   |
| match_result          | [Any](`typing.Any`) | Optional :class:`~timetoalign.alignment.matching.MatchResult`. If provided, unmatched target notes are recorded as deletions and unmatched source notes as insertions. | `None`                       |
| piece                 | [str](`str`)        | Piece name for the header.                                                                                                                                             | `''`                         |
| composer              | [str](`str`)        | Composer name for the header.                                                                                                                                          | `''`                         |
| performer             | [str](`str`)        | Performer name for the header.                                                                                                                                         | `''`                         |
| score_filename        | [str](`str`)        | Score file name for the header.                                                                                                                                        | `''`                         |
| midi_filename         | [str](`str`)        | MIDI file name for the header.                                                                                                                                         | `''`                         |
| midi_clock_units      | [int](`int`)        | MIDI divisions per quarter note.                                                                                                                                       | `480`                        |
| midi_clock_rate       | [int](`int`)        | Microseconds per quarter note.                                                                                                                                         | `500000`                     |
| score_coord_column    | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with the score coordinate.                                                                                                                        | `'quarterbeats_playthrough'` |
| perf_coord_column     | [str](`str`)        | Column in *perf_df* with the performance coordinate.                                                                                                                   | `'start'`                    |
| score_pitch_column    | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with the pitch name.                                                                                                                              | `'pitch'`                    |
| perf_pitch_column     | [str](`str`)        | Column in *perf_df* with the pitch name.                                                                                                                               | `'pitch'`                    |
| score_staff_column    | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with the staff number.                                                                                                                            | `'staff'`                    |
| score_duration_column | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with note duration (in quarter-beats).  Falls back to ``"duration"`` if missing.                                                                  | `'duration_qb'`              |
| score_measure_column  | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with measure number.                                                                                                                              | `'mc'`                       |
| score_beat_column     | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with beat number.                                                                                                                                 | `'beat'`                     |
| score_offset_column   | [str](`str`)        | Column in *score_df* with beat offset.                                                                                                                                 | `'mc_onset'`                 |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                      | Description                            |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
|        | [MatchFileContext](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.MatchFileContext`) | A populated :class:`MatchFileContext`. |
